ZONINGLOT AGREEMENT This ZONING LOT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement”)made as of February 29,2012, between Carey LLC, M & A Residences Inc., 41 Murray Street LLC, each having an office at 41-43 Murray Street, New York, NY 10007, (hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Owner,”"), and 37W Owmer LLC, hereinafter referred to as the “Developer," having an office at c/o Paul Hastings,75East 55thStreet,NewYork,NY 10022. RECITALS: WHEREAS, the Owner is the fee owner of certain land (the “Owner's Land") with the street address of 41-43 Murray Street, New York, NY 10007, which is located in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Block 133 Lots 1001, 1002, and 1003 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, more particularly described by a metes and bounds together with any improvements, buildings or other structures existing thereon, and any alterations, additions to, or replacements thereof, and any new buildings that may exist thereon (the "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, the Developer is the fee owner of certain land (the“Developer's Land") with the streetaddressof37WarrenStreet,NewYork,NY10007,locatedintheCityandStateofNew York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Block 133, Lot 29 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Schedule B, annexed hereto and by this reference made a part hereof, together with any improvements, buildings or other structures existing thereon, and any alterations, additions to, or replacements thereof, and any new buildings that may exist thereon (the “"Developer's Property"); WHEREAS, the unit owners of 37 Murray Street ("37 Murray Condo") are the fee owners of certainland("37MurrayCondo's Land")with thestreet addressof 37-39MurrayStreet(a/k/a 126-130 Church Street), New York,NY 10007,located in the City and State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, designated as Block 133, Lots 1301-1311 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, more particularly described by a metes and bounds description set forth in Schedule C, annexed hereto and by this reference made a part hereof, together with any improvements, buildings or other structures existing thereon, and any alterations, additions to, or replacements  thereof, and any new buildings that may exist thereon ("37 Murray Condo's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer's Land and 37 Murray Condo's Land are within a single block and are contiguous for at least ten (10) linear feet; WHEREAS, pursuant to the Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, recorded in the Office of the City Register of the City of New York on September 29, 2003 at CRFN 2003000397745, Developer's Land and 37 Murray Condo's Land (together, the “Zoning Lot") have been merged into a single zoning lot, as defined in the New York City Zoning Resolution, effective December 15, 1961, as amended (the “Zoning Resolution");
